entries.version: v1.0.7 — 24 Core Features Suite Expansion & Interactive Showcase Release
changes: Expanded flagship to 24 Core Features master catalog: searchable, category-filterable (redirection/compliance/automation/monetization/analytics) UI with expandable operational logic, location, how-to and expected-result cards — see src/content/cloaker.json:207 (coreFeatures24 24 items) and src/app/products/smart-affiliate-link-cloaker/page.tsx:291 (filter + search + expandable cards).

Home & flagship showcase overhaul: live link transformation demo (raw https://network.com/aff_c?offer_id=892... → branded https://yoursite.com/go/best-vpn) with copy button, 4 stat badges (+25%–40% CTR, wp_posts, Amazon §6, 1-Click Stripe), 3-tab spotlight (24 Features / Use Cases / Admin Navigation) and hover-elevated pillars — see src/app/page.tsx:14 (activeFeatureTab+copied), src/content/home.json:14 (5-item trustBar + 4 refined pillars).

Products directory interactive explorer: 24-feature mini-catalog with category pills (all/redirection/compliance/automation/monetization/analytics), tech-stack / target-audience / 8-submenu admin menu 3-column spec, and gradient hero — see src/app/products/page.tsx:92 (mini-explorer) and src/content/products.json:14 (techStack 8 items + 6+6 keyFeatures).

Product page 8-tab sticky navigation (Overview & Pillars / 24 Features / Scenarios / Admin Tour / Guide / Target / Glossary / FAQ): before→after permalink visuals, 4-tile architecture grid (salc_link / RewriteEngine / RedirectEngine / ClickTracker), 6-scenario without/with toggles, simulated WP Admin sidebar (Link Cloaker + 8 submenus), phase-guided user guide, audience matrix, searchable 18-term glossary and category-filtered 15-FAQ accordion — see src/app/products/smart-affiliate-link-cloaker/page.tsx:121 (sticky tabs), src/content/cloaker.json:31 (navigation 8 submenus).

Docs Hub overhaul: hero tagged v1.0.6 (24 Core Features), searchable 9-chapter manual with badges (Overview/Core Value/Admin UI/Master Reference/Use Cases/Target Audience/Architecture/Glossary/FAQs), copy-section button and verified footer — see src/app/docs/page.tsx:48 (hero+search) and src/content/docs.json:3 (hero + 9 index items with expanded 5-pillar, 24-feature, 6-scenario, 8-submenu, 18-glossary, 15-FAQ content).

Build verified Next.js 16.3.2 (Turbopack) — ✓ Compiled successfully in ~1659ms — 13 static routes prerendered — live at https://vibepressstudio.vercel.app (x-nextjs-prerender, x-vercel-cache: PRERENDER).

entries.version: v0.3.0 — Brand Redesign & Studio Lab Polish
changes: Integrated complete Google Stitch Design System with custom color tokens, Inter/JetBrains Mono typography, and responsive layouts.
Renamed top navigation menu from 'Marketplace' to 'Studio' and migrated page route from /pricing to /lab (301 redirect in next.config.ts:12).
Added SVG brand logo to Header, Mobile Drawer, and Footer, along with modern vector favicon (icon.svg).
Fixed primary button and tab text contrast ensuring full WCAG AAA compliance.
Rebranded site to pre-launch registration posture; added pricing/lab portal, cloaker status (100% Feature Complete) and ShelfMaster 80% readiness content.
Rewrote docs hub (Cloaker 5 phases, ShelfMaster 6 chapters), products directory, and navigation/footer to single pre-launch tier (preLaunchUrl: /lab).
Removed legacy legal pages and Freemius/AppSumo distribution URLs; verified 17 static routes and sitemap.

entries.version: v1.0.6 (Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker) — Core Compliance & Routing
changes: Implemented strict FTC auto-disclosure injector (<aside role="note"> callout/badge/minimal/subtle at top/bottom/before_first_link).
Added support for 307 temporary redirects (default uncached) and 200 iFrame masking with branded gradient.
Full compatibility with WordPress 6.0+ and PHP 8.0+ (WPCS/PSR-12), local click analytics (wp_salc_clicks, 7 charts, CSV export).
